# ScoreCard

One score readout in two layouts: hero, the meal screen's big numeral with what changed and a progress bar, and compact, a smaller card for household, health a…

`NomNom.ScoreCard` · Ratings

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.ScoreCard score={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.ScoreCard" score="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ScoreCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'hero' \| 'compact'` | @default 'hero' |
| `variant` | `'primary'` | 'primary' features the score (health): tinted card, primary label, larger numeral. |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Glyph before the title, e.g. 'leaf'. |
| `caption` | `string` | One line under the bar. |
| `score` * | `number \| null` | 0–100; null = unrated ("—", "Unrated"). |
| `verdict` | `string` | @default verdict for the score |
| `title` | `string` | Uppercase label, e.g. 'Household score'. |
| `delta` | `number` | Signed change; renders a Badge (primary up, warning down, secondary flat). |
| `deltaText` | `string` | Hero only: the sentence after the delta Badge. |
| `deltaReference` | `string` |  |
| `count` | `string` | e.g. '12 meals'. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | Makes the card a button with a chevron. |
